notes: Entries are unique by original date and normalized announcement text. Repeated announcements on different dates remain separate.
Only markup, escaped newlines/quotes, whitespace, and long-dash punctuation are normalized. Original text, dates (including the recorded August 2016 date), and ticket references are retained.
Deferred items retain their deferred status. An inventory update is not needed when contributing a new entry.

Added: CLI connectivity improvements in v0.2.11: deduped JSON accessors reduce redundant data fetching, HTTP reachability checks are pooled across commands, and connection allocation is pinned per-request. Added: MCP and CLI can now update existing time entries via POST /api/mcp/time/update (HTTP 400 if neither minutes nor date is provided), and POST /api/mcp/time/delete via entry_id; no separate /api/mcp/time/log delete action exists, and hypertask_time log remains CLI-only for manual entry (HTPR-4725)
Added: Free users on web are capped at 3 owned boards across all creation surfaces (app, CLI, MCP, manifest, AI chat) and receive upgrade prompts when the limit is reached (HTPR-4894)
Added: Free setup now provides 100 credit-machines (web/desktop) + 30 credit-machines (mobile) per user, matching the engine's paid tier defaults when proven through adoption or contact (HTPR-4993)
Added: Free users now get 3 machine credits per platform (web 100, desktop 100, mobile 30) at signup, scaling with verified use or contact for higher tiers (HTPR-1067)
Added: Open Latest Updates via command palette from any route (HTPR-4813)
Fixed: Agent comments now properly create inbox notifications for mentioned users, including cases where an agent mentions its owner (HTPR-4229)
Added: Board columns now expand to full container height when the quick-tips bar is hidden on the board view, so they fill the available space cleanly (HTPR-4967)
Added: Task detail view now shows start dates with natural language presets and supports clearing them; start dates affect how My tasks orders your work (HTPR-4884)
Added: Tasks can be saved as templates from the command palette and reused from the board, preserving fields like title, description, priority, size, and labels (HTPR-4886)

Added: AI status updates appear on task cards when an AI agent updates task metadata in a visible way; changes include priority, assignees, labels, due dates, and related tasks, visible on cards, task detail, and notifications via Write with AI (HTPR-4888)
Added: Today / Upcoming / Later surface across My tasks boards with date grouping and consistent keyboard navigation (HTPR-4887)
Added: Swipe-through-unread card stack for mobile inbox via Ctrl+K with right/left swipe or arrow keys, undo, and bulk archive on exit (HTPR-4969)
Added: Ctrl+K Get started group for first-time users: Create task, AI Task Writer, Invite people, Create board, Add column, plus CLI/MCP seeding for guest boards (HTPR-4959)

Added: Custom fields page and in-app help are live (creating fields, rail values, table sorting + columns picker, ICE-ranking recipe, agent/API section with curl examples) (HTPR-4979)
Improved: Vercel production builds no longer hang; median deployment time is ~4.4 min, slowest ~4.8 min, with no timeout behavior (agent sessions no longer interfere) (HTPR-4031)
Added: Time reports now support date presets (Yesterday, Last week, Last month, Custom with From/To fields) and clickable durations that open the time log modal (HTPR-4934)
Added: Time reports entry form has separate Hours and Minutes fields for clear duration entry, and supports split hours/minutes input (HTPR-4934)
Added: Guest onboarding creates a demo board and opens the AI Task Writer with a prompt so new users can immediately experience AI task creation (HTPR-4937)
Improved: Inactive tab labels in the view cluster now render at 90% opacity; on AMOLED, the icon rail and inbox container sit on pure #000 with their hairline edges kept (HTPR-4943)
Fixed: React crash on project pages with no board ID no longer occurs (HTPR-4847)
Fixed: React crash on project pages with no board ID no longer occurs (HTPR-4847)
Fixed: App no longer crashes in headless Chrome due to dictation MicVAD errors (HTPR-4085)
Added: Board switcher now tops the left rail with Ctrl+B board palette, and inbox joins the view icons in view cluster (HTPR-4835)
Improved: Inbox mention rows now display sender, @name pill + message snippet, ticket ID, title, tags, and date in mention-first order (HTPR-4812)
Improved: Inbox card layout hugs the bottom when quick tips are off and rises with the quick-tips bar; dead 36px gap removed (HTPR-4898)

Improved: Left sidebar expanded to 130px with user labels for logged-in users; collapsed by default with chevron toggle and persistent state; right tooltips show all real keyboard shortcuts including for rail (HTPR-4890)
Added: Signing in with a guest session now transfers the guest team, its boards, and memberships to the new account, with guest UIDs re-prefixed so that cleanup cron can still find them (HTPR-4893)
Added: Two new themes -"Light (New)" and "Dark (New)" with refined accents and improved visual consistency across the app (HTPR-4906)
Improved: Sidebar elements now render with subtle hairlines for better visual distinction, and table view row borders use refined styling (HTPR-4906)
Added: Graphite/Porcelain become the system-theme defaults and the graphite left-sidebar outline is dropped (HTPR-4909)

Improved keyboard shortcuts - Ctrl+Q now focuses the docked AI chat input on /chat and on boards (when the chat is open) - focus jumps to the input even if the panel is docked or pressed when closed (HTPR-4416)
Added rail-accessible timer controls - an optional Rail Timer icon on boards with active time tracks toggles the running-timers page, and Alt+T starts/stops a timer directly on a task (HTPR-4415)
Fixed theme readability of staleness age line - on light and paper themes the age line renders in amber-600/red-600 instead of yellow-on-white (HTPR-4413)

Fixed: Agent bearer tokens now correctly attribute writes to the agent - When an autonomous agent authenticated with its own bearer token created tasks or posted comments, the operations were incorrectly attributed to the agent's human owner. Writes are now correctly attributed to the agent, making activity logs and notifications accurately reflect the agent as the actor. (HTPR-3684)

Added: Most pages now use compact modal header sizing; modals have 48px/16px header, 44px/14px input, and 36px/13px rows by default, with legacy sizing opt-in via legacySizing prop for compatibility (HTPR-4742)

Added: Left sidebar rail now expands to 130px for logged-in users, with user labels, accordion accordions, and Favorites section at the bottom; collapsed by default with chevron toggle and persistent state (HTPR-4738)
